name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny line or bar trend with no axes, next to a figure.

when: A trend beside a stat or in a table cell.

instead.when: Readers need axes, values or several series.
The current figure and its change are enough.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: An aria-label that summarizes the trend.

genui.description: A tiny trend with no axes, next to a figure.
